finding:
THE BARREL LADDER IS FLAT BELOW THE BOARD FLOOR, AND THE FREE RUNG IS WHERE THE VALUE IS.  At the GND netclass via (0.60/0.30 mm) 32 of 75 guarded pads bond.  At 0.50/0.25 mm -- exactly this board's min_via_diameter, needing NO rule-area licence -- 7 MORE bond and retirable tubes go 12 -> 17 of 46.  At 0.45/0.20 mm, 4 more (C23.1, C7.2, R40.2, U2.12) for 20 of 46, and at 0.35/0.20 mm -- the finest process this board licenses by name -- EXACTLY THE SAME ELEVEN.  So a licence buys three tubes and nothing below 0.45 mm buys anything at all.

AND THE SEVEN FREE BONDS ARE NOT PROMOTABLE TODAY, FOR THE RIGHT REASON.  They lay cleanly -- 7 of 7, zero regressions, zero attributable DRC -- but bond redundancy CLOSES NO EDGE by construction: the pads it serves were already connected.  Gate clause 4 requires the board to IMPROVE, so a pure-robustness batch has to ride along with a route that closes one, exactly as D-600's 32 rode with /I2C_SCL_INT.  Four nets were offered as that partner and all four declined: /I2C_SDA_INT, BTN_DOWN_N and EXT_SDA are NO_PATH even with five more tubes retired, and /I2C_SCL_INT does not close a second edge.  Those three walls are therefore NOT the pour-bond guard -- they are corridor capacity, which is the same diagnosis the USB link carries.  Clause 4 was NOT weakened to admit this batch and must not be: a run that does not improve the board is not a promotion.

READY PAYLOAD.  The seven pads, the 0.50/0.25 mm barrel and d601-pour-bond-guard-bonded.json (29 tubes) are a measured, executable batch.  Attach them to the FIRST future run that closes an edge anywhere on the board and they promote with it at no extra risk.

trials.verdict: REFUSED: board did not improve (--promote raised "refuse promotion: gate failed", so no run report was written; the numbers here are read from the run work tree /tmp/d601b ledger-before.json / ledger-mid.json / drc.json)
